users (table)
- Id: INTEGER NOT NULL
- Reputation: INTEGER
- CreationDate: DATETIME
- DisplayName: TEXT
- LastAccessDate: DATETIME
- WebsiteUrl: TEXT
- Location: TEXT
- AboutMe: TEXT
- Views: INTEGER
- UpVotes: INTEGER
- DownVotes: INTEGER
- AccountId: INTEGER
- Age: INTEGER
- ProfileImageUrl: TEXT
PRIMARY KEY (Id)

posts (table)
- Id: INTEGER NOT NULL
- PostTypeId: INTEGER
- AcceptedAnswerId: INTEGER
- CreaionDate: DATETIME
- Score: INTEGER
- ViewCount: INTEGER
- Body: TEXT
- OwnerUserId: INTEGER
- LasActivityDate: DATETIME
- Title: TEXT
- Tags: TEXT
- AnswerCount: INTEGER
- CommentCount: INTEGER
- FavoriteCount: INTEGER
- LastEditorUserId: INTEGER
- LastEditDate: DATETIME
- CommunityOwnedDate: DATETIME
- ParentId: INTEGER
- ClosedDate: DATETIME
- OwnerDisplayName: TEXT
- LastEditorDisplayName: TEXT
PRIMARY KEY (Id)
FOREIGN KEY (LastEditorUserId) REFERENCES users (Id)
FOREIGN KEY (OwnerUserId) REFERENCES users (Id)
FOREIGN KEY (ParentId) REFERENCES posts (Id)

arguments.sql:
SELECT u.Location, COUNT(*) AS profile_count
FROM users AS u
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%United Kingdom%'
GROUP BY u.Location
ORDER BY profile_count DESC, u.Location
LIMIT 40
